$comment: Era 02 selection card. Note what is ABSENT: no stake, no price_obtained_by_owner, no settled_pl_gbp, no bank. Those fields existed in Era 01 and are deliberately not carried over. `result` is recorded because it is a fact, and is explicitly NOT the score -- see scored_on.

decision_price.description: Best exchange price available when the call was made.

closing_price.description: Raw closing price. DERIVED ONLY. Null until sourced.

closing_fair_price.description: Closing price with margin removed. The benchmark.

clv_pp.description: closing fair probability minus decision probability, in pp. The score.

ev_per_10_gbp.description: (closing fair probability x decision price - 1) x 10.

result.description: Recorded as fact. NOT the score.
